snippet.title: Impirical Evidence - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
👇 WISHLIST ON STEAM NOW! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4345520/Impirical_Evidence/

Arthur Marley is a professional Paranormal Debunker. He has used science, logic, and a healthy dose of arrogance to prove that the paranormal isn't real. He was the best at denying the impossible... until he accidentally summoned it.

Meet Murray: a chaotic, electric Imp who is now physically bound to Arthur.

Impirical Evidence is a comedy point-and-click adventure game built with modern direct controls and a unique art style. Use Arthur's logic and Murray's supernatural abilities to solve inventory-based puzzles, expose frauds, and navigate a world where bureaucracy clashes with magic.

#ImpiricalEvidence #AdventureGame #IndieGame #PointAndClick #GameTrailer
